name: TransmogInventoryReady
summary: The `inventoryServicesReady` member body of the Transmog replicated state: one strict zero-or-one byte. The client's reader refuses any other value, so the card declares bool_byte and the codec refuses a byte above 1.
purpose: Name the member layout that the Transmog presence mask selects (group 0 member 4 of codec.transmog-replicated-state).

fields.name: ready
fields.note: One raw byte read by 0x1417b4c20 through FUN_1408787b0; the reader stores it only when it is below 2. Measured 1. The meaning is inferred from the member name and is NOT proven, so it stays layout-only.

evidence.ref: research/fixtures/wire/state-fragment-5691.hex: the final byte is 01; byte-exact round trip.
